comments.body: This call now rejects through RTK Query's `.unwrap()`, which throws a `FetchBaseQueryError` or `SerializedError` plain object, not a real `Error` instance. The `catch` block below still checks `error instanceof Error`, which is usually false for this rejection type, so the user sees the generic "Unknown error" text even when the API returned a real message. Consider reusing the `getErrorMessage` helper (already used in `MainPage.tsx` and `DetailPanel.tsx`) so the shown message reflects the actual failure.

`Number(import.meta.env.VITE_CACHE_TTL) || 60` falls back to 60 whenever the parsed value is `0` (or `NaN`), so it is not possible to explicitly disable caching by setting the env var to `0`. A check like `Number.isNaN(...)` would preserve an intentional `0`.

The loading overlay (`
Loading...
`) has no `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`. Screen reader users get no announcement that new results are loading. Adding a live region here would make the loading state accessible.
